authority: PI, 2026-09-16: A has served its purpose as the healthy control; continuing A experiments risks a two-headed hydra when only B is sick. Stop working on A does not mean stop evaluating against A.
THE_RULE_ONE_SENTENCE: A is frozen. B is the repair target. No experiment unless it can help explain or improve Δ_B at 4v4/6v6.

A_FREEZE_RULE.verbatim: π_A is considered operationally solved for the current specialization-repair program. No further A training, tuning, architecture changes, reward changes, or A-specific diagnostics are permitted unless a future B-side intervention demonstrably causes a regression in Δ_A or a required integrity/control check specifically requires A. π_A may be used only as a frozen comparator/control. All repair effort is directed toward π_B and the failure of Δ_B at 4v4 and 6v6.
A_FREEZE_RULE.why: A's AB_BEHAVIORAL_TRAJECTORY cells already show substantial macro oscillation during training that does not map cleanly onto performance (GO_TO-heavy@100k with higher win; GET_FLAG recovery@200k with lower win; healthy aggression+performance by mid/late training). Bfinal's endpoint macro signature therefore describes where B ended up, not necessarily why specialization eroded. The sealed corrected B win/score trajectory (PEAK_THEN_DECLINE) remains the primary established performance fact.
A_FREEZE_RULE.distinction: stop working on A ≠ stop evaluating against A. Δ_B = V(π_B, B) − V(π_A, B) still requires frozen A as the measuring stick; we do not spend training budget changing the measuring stick.
